get.summary: Get Factura Recibida Cuentas Iva Historicas
get.description:
Resolve a VAT account from exact, real and read-only journal history.

Each historical invoice must link to its real ``FR`` journal, contain one
active VAT slot and have exactly one ``472`` line whose net amount matches
that slot's quota. No account number is inferred from the tax rate alone.

get.summary: Get Factura Recibida Cuentas Gasto Historicas
get.description:
Rank real expense accounts previously stored for a provider.

This read-only endpoint uses the four FRR expense account/amount pairs. It
does not mix analytical CTB rows, journal lines or the provider's current
default account with historical invoice usage.

get.description:
Suggest a regime only from strongly consistent, circuit-safe history.

The endpoint is read-only. It never maps an IVA percentage directly to a
regime and never mixes equal numeric provider ids from the two ERP masters.
